# device-passport

> Digital device passports for scrapers, bots and automation. 100% consistent, stateful browser personas with sticky hardware, correlated Client-Hints, and geo-aligned locales.

- GitHub: https://github.com/webkubor/device-passport
- Package: device-passport
- License: MIT

## Core Philosophy

Traditional scrapers get blocked because their User-Agents fluctuate randomly across sessions (the "Shapeshifter Anomaly"), lack high-entropy Client-Hints, or mismatch their proxy IP's geographic timezone.
`device-passport` generates an immutable, physically plausible 4-tuple persona $P = \langle \mathcal{H}, \mathcal{S}, \mathcal{G}, \mathcal{C} \rangle$ where hardware, OS, locale, and headers are strictly correlated and persistent.

## Key APIs

```typescript
import { createPassport, PassportManager } from 'device-passport'

// 1. One-liner sticky passport
const passport = createPassport('account_user_1', { geo: 'US' })
console.log(passport.headers)
console.log(passport.userAgent)
console.log(passport.timezone)

// 2. Playwright integration
const context = await browser.newContext(passport.playwrightContext)

// 3. Self-evaluation score
const report = passport.evaluate() // Grade A+ (100% coherence)

// 4. Multi-account fleet management
const manager = new PassportManager({ store: './passports.json', defaultGeo: 'US' })
const p = manager.getPassport('alice')
```
